members.name: Dominique Makowski
members.details: Consciousness, perception, and the nature of subjective experience.
members.title: Lecturer in Psychology
members.summary:
Trained as a clinical neuropsychologist and CBT psychotherapist, Dominique Makowski is a lecturer at the University of Sussex studying how people construct, bend, and experience reality.

His work spans altered states of consciousness, illusion, deception, fake news, meditation, and immersive experience, with an emphasis on making advanced psychological methods more accessible through open-source tools.

education.details: Focused on the neuroscience of reality perception and the mechanisms through which subjective experience can be bent, stabilized, or disrupted.
Combined clinical assessment, rehabilitation, and therapeutic training with a strong grounding in affective and cognitive neuroscience.
Built the experimental, statistical, and theoretical foundations that later shaped his work on consciousness, perception, and methodology.

members.hook: Did you know that Dominique Makowski created the easystats ecosystem for R?
